name: Rare Earth
tagline: Two hundred and seventy-nine plots across eighteen acres.
description: Rare Earth is a MUDA-approved plotted development on the Mysuru–Ooty road at Kadakola. Two hundred and seventy-nine plots sit across 73,552 sq m — a little over eighteen acres — with more than a tenth of the site given to park, and a further 3,774 sq m to civic amenities. It is 280 metres from NH 766 and about two kilometres from Mysore airport.

contentWarnings: RERA field on the live page renders the literal string 'NUMBER GOES HERE'.

Specifications omitted. The live page lists interior finishes — engineered marble, wood laminate, Jaquar or Kohler sanitary fittings, premium paints — on a development that sells bare land. Not carried over.
All eight amenities and all six gallery images are dead links on the live page.

Plot sizes and counts taken from the approved MUDA layout (Authority Resolution 14, 08-08-2024), which answers question (i) of the information request. Net extent 18A-07G, 73,551.61 sq m; land use 54.79% residential, 29.45% roads, 10.18% park, 5.13% civic amenities, 0.45% public utility.
The approved drawing is titled "1st Phase (40%) Site Release". The 279 sites are the full layout; confirm how many are released for sale today before the plan implies all of them are.
Eighty-three plots are irregular ("Odd") on the approved drawing and have no single stated dimension. They are counted but not sized.

Connectivity is the project brochure's own kilometre figures. The live site published a different set as travel times (JSS Multispecialty 15 min, Seshadripuram 10 min, Christ College 15 min, Mall of Mysore 15 min, Nexus 25 min, Apollo 25 min, GC Sports Medicine 15 min, JSS Public School 13 min). The two sets name different places and cannot be reconciled; the brochure is the newer client document and wins. Confirm before print.
The brochure master plan legend marks the entrance 'Toll Plaza' alongside 'Grand Archway'. Recorded here as the archway only — confirm what the gatehouse should be called for buyers.
